name: NGC 7293 螺旋星云（上帝之眼）
orientation: east-left-north-up; row 0 south; columns increase west
status: LVM measured Ha/OIII/NII in qualified fiber footprints; deblended SHASSA/DSS2 fallback assumed outside

levels.label: LVM Hα / OIII / NII
levels.source: Sánchez et al. 2026 LVM DR19 corrected named-column line fluxes. 35.3 arcsec aperture means; DSS2 fallback is an estimate deblended with the integrated LVM NII/Ha ratio.
levels.calibration: 1 table unit = 1e-19 W/m2 per fiber; divide by pi*(17.65 arcsec in radians)^2. Independent S/N>3 masks, overlapping aperture means averaged; NII6548/6583=1/3 assumed.

stars.encoding: float32-le [X, Y, F550 W/m2/nm, Tcolour K]
stars.limits: Gaia G<15 within 2°, G<12.5 to 5.7°; Hipparcos V<7
stars.model: Black body at Ballesteros (2012) colour temperature from B−V (Gaia BP−RP inverted via DR3 Table 5.9), normalized to Bessell (1998) V=0 flux at 550 nm; observed (reddened) colours.

template.source: Case B Balmer ratios (Storey & Hummer 1995); [O III] 4959/5007 = 1/2.98; low-density [S II] 6716/6731 = 1.4; continuum EW(Hβ)=1370 Å (assumed). Other lines missing. D61: separate LVM [N II]6583 map, [N II]6548/6583 energy ratio 1/3 (assumed atomic companion); SII unavailable.

notes: D61：在实测光纤区域分别使用 Hα、[O III]5007、[N II]6583 辐亮度；[N II]6548 按 1/3 能量比伴线计算。第三线图通道现在是 NII，SII 仍缺测。
SHASSA 红图含部分 NII：先按 T6548/THα=0.5、T6583/THα=1/3 及积分 NII6583/Hα=1.698619 分解，再逐线经过模拟滤镜；DSS2 未测区沿用相同近似拆分，不能视为纯线实测。
用户 600s 单帧原标度未通过测光一致性检查，且实际滤带未知；新版亮度采用 35.3″ LVM 数据，不让该单帧覆盖实测值。原始单帧及旧版数据仍完整保留。
sources: SHASSA (Gaustad et al. 2001, PASP 113, 1326), continuum-subtracted Hα in deci-Rayleigh, ~0.8′; via CDS hips2fits (ov-gso/P/SHASSA)
DSS2 red/blue (STScI Digitized Sky Survey II; UK Schmidt SERC-ER / SERC-J plates, AAO/ROE)
[O III] 5007/Hβ = 4.97 whole nebula: Sánchez et al. 2026, SDSS-V LVM Helix (arXiv:2602.10072); O'Dell 1998 gives 5.76
Gaia DR3 (I/355/gaiadr3) and Hipparcos (I/239) via VizieR TAP
Sánchez et al. 2026, arXiv:2602.10072, corrected DR19 DAP line table (SHA pinned locally).
Gaustad et al. 2001, arXiv:astro-ph/0108518, SHASSA Ha/NII transmission §2.2/§4.
